title: Asian property firms shift from owning more to earning more

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Major property companies across Asia are selling mature assets to fund new investments, reduce debt, and expand recurring-income businesses. The strategy reflects a shift in how developers measure success: less by the size of their portfolios and more by the returns they generate. Known as capital recycling, the approach allows developers to recover funds tied up in existing properties and reinvest them elsewhere. Companies can also sell buildings to real estate investment trusts (REITs) or private funds while continuing to earn management fees, allowing them to unlock capital without completely giving up their involvement in the assets.
